pages.narration:
Prakash’s mother calls out to Velamma. “Is everyone ready for tomorrow’s trip? Have they packed their bags? What about Rajesh?”  

Velamma replies, “We’re all packed and ready. If their exams are finished, they’ll join us. We wish we could be there—we would have joined you all.”

pages.narration: It’s Sunday, and someone calls out, “Bring me something from there, Nija.” At last, Nija can finally spend some time close to Velamma. A sharp “ding!” rings, followed by a deep “dong,” and the names Yawasaki and Nurja echo in the air.
